column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Luca, the Pope, and the door of truth
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: At last... you have come this far.
You can't bring yourself to fight me seriously!?
(No! I am the one who is not fighting seriously!!)
Say something! Who... are you, really?
Even wearing $$メタトロン$$'s armor, it does not devour you!
Just as I thought... you are...
Your role is over. That will be all.
As expected of you, to make it this far... truly impressive. And therefore all the more pitiful.
You want to meet our child, do you not!?
Then she is atop this altar.
Come. Now is the time. Have courage and open the door to the truth!!
